source.title: Call for Applicants - WQAC Leader (October 2023)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Quality Assurance Committee Leader, as Daniel Vædele Egdal’s term is ending. We would like to thank Daniel for the work he has done leading the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee.

**The skills and attributes expected of candidates are:**

* Passionate about quality improvement in the WCA
* Committed to ensuring the WCA adopts consistent high-quality processes
* A critical thinker with strong analytical abilities
* Leadership and decision-making skills
* Proficient in producing and analyzing quality assessment reports
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively 


The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **November 13th, 2023, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

 <!-- break -->
 
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WQAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WQAC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2021.8.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.8%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf)

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)


Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会负责人招募（2023 年 10 月）
translation.content:
Daniel Vædele Egdal 的任期即将结束，WCA 将任命新的质量保证委员会负责人。感谢 Daniel 在任期间带领委员会所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作。

**申请人应具备以下技能和素质：**

* 热心改善 WCA 的工作质量
* 愿意推动 WCA 持续采用统一、高质量的工作流程
* 善于独立思考，具备较强的分析能力
* 具备领导和决策能力
* 熟练编写和分析质量评估报告
* 沟通能力出色
* 能够与他人合作

申请时间为即日起至 **2023 年 11 月 13 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

* 简短的个人介绍
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
* 担任 WQAC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WQAC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2021.8](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.8%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢各位申请和支持。
